1) the ACR-MCS negotiation strategy is efficient because agents adopting this strategy negotiate optimally and 2) the InterCloud coalition formation strategy results in every agent in the InterCloud coalition receiving its Shapley payoff.

1) ACR-MSC is the best strategy for many-to-many consumer-cloud negotiation and 2) InterCloud coalition formation is achieved by the four-stage interaction protocol that is based on the Shapley value and a set of strategies that converge to a sub game perfect equilibrium.

1) an agent-based economic model of the InterCloud can be devised by modeling consumer-to-cloud interactions as many-to-many negotiations and cloud-to-cloud interaction as a coalition game; 2) the ACR-MCS negotiation strategy achieves optimal outcomes and the four-stage cloud-to- cloud interaction protocol achieves efficient outcomes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and analysis of an intelligent InterCloud that facilitates the interactions among consumers, cloud providers and cloud service brokers.
devising novel interaction protocols and negotiation and coalition formation strategies for an InterCloud.

the design of an intelligent InterCloud that is characterized by 1) a many-to-many agent-based consumer-to-cloud economic model, 2) a novel negotiation strategy for consumers and cloud providers, 3) a novel four-stage agent-based InterCloud coalition formation economic model, and 4) a novel set of strategies for cloud providers in the InterCloud.
